mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 300 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in PAYEMS (above 156000) and INDPRO (above 102.5) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 156000 AND INDPRO > 102.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 300), a federal funds rate decline below 4.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing response, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 AND FEDFUNDS < 4.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts figure below 1400 (thousands of units) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in INDPRO (above 102.5) and decline in UNRATE (below 3.8) indicates strong supply-side economic conditions, supporting corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 102.5 AND UNRATE < 3.8 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A real personal savings figure below 680000 (millions of dollars) signals deteriorating consumer financial health, which reduces spending power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 680000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level below 20000 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) indicates economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 20000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).
